ქვემოთ 12 კითხვაა, რომლებიც ხელშეკრულები: Below are 12 questions to ask any web agency, web development company or freelancer before you sign a contract. Their answers will tell you much more than a nice presentation.
1. შეგიძლიათ მაჩვენოთ რეალური, მოქმედი ს: 1. Can you show me real, live websites?
სქრინშოტები და მაკეტები საკმარისი არ არი: Screenshots and mockups aren't enough. Ask for links to live sites and open them on your phone yourself: how fast they load, how easy they are to use, whether the forms work. You can see our projects on the work page.
2. გქონიათ ჩვენნაირი პროექტი?: 2. Have you done a project like ours?
ონლაინ მაღაზია, კორპორატიული საიტი და ჯა: An online store, a corporate site and a booking system each require different experience. A similar project doesn't mean the agency has to come from your industry, but it should know the type of task.
სანდო სააგენტოს ამ კითხვის არ ეშინია. ერ: A reliable agency isn't afraid of this question. One short call with a client will tell you whether they kept to deadlines and how they behaved when problems came up.
4. ვინ იმუშავებს ჩემს პროექტზე?: 4. Who will work on my project?
გაიგეთ, ვინ იქნება თქვენი საკონტაქტო პირ: Find out who your contact person will be, who designs and who writes the code. In some cases one team talks to you during the sale, and completely different people do the work.
კარგ სააგენტოს მკაფიო ეტაპები აქვს: კვლე: A good agency has clear stages: research and structure, design, development, testing, launch. Ask them to explain what you approve at each stage and how many revisions you're entitled to.
6. როგორ გავიგებ, სად არის პროექტი?: 6. How will I know where the project is?
ყოველკვირეული სტატუსი, საერთო სამუშაო სი: A weekly status update, a shared workspace, a demo version: whatever the form, you should know what's happening and not have to wait months for an answer.
7. რომელ პლატფორმაზე ააწყობთ საიტს და რა: 7. Which platform will you build the site on, and why?
პასუხი თქვენი ამოცანიდან უნდა გამომდინარ: The answer should follow from your task, not from the agency's habit. If they offer every client the same platform, that's a warning sign. More on the choice in the article WordPress or custom code.
8. გათვალისწინებულია SEO და სისწრაფე?: 8. Are SEO and speed taken into account?
ტექნიკური SEO — სწორი სათაურები, აღწერებ: Technical SEO (correct titles, descriptions, structure, sitemap, speed) should be part of the work from the start. If an agency offers SEO as an “extra service after launch”, ask what exactly they mean.
9. ჩემით შევძლებ ტექსტებისა და ფოტოების: 9. Will I be able to change texts and photos myself?
ყოველი მცირე ცვლილებისთვის დეველოპერთან: Calling a developer for every small change costs both time and money. Ask to see the admin panel and for a guide to using it.
10. რას მოიცავს ფასი და რა არის დამატები: 10. What does the price include, and what is extra?
დიზაინი, დეველოპმენტი, ტექსტები, ფოტოები: Design, development, texts, photos, translation, hosting, domain, licences, technical support: find out which are included in the price. We write about what goes into the cost of a website in the article how much does a website cost.
11. ვის ეკუთვნის საიტი, კოდი და წვდომები: 11. Who owns the site, the code and the access details?
დომენი და ჰოსტინგი თქვენს სახელზე უნდა ი: The domain and hosting should be registered in your name, and the admin access and code should be in your hands. This should be written directly into the contract, so you can move to another team if needed.
საიტს სჭირდება განახლება, სარეზერვო ასლე: A site needs updates, backups and protection. Ask how long they fix bugs for free and how much monthly technical support costs.

ეს იშვიათი შემთხვევა არ არის. საქართველო: This isn't a rare case. In Georgia people often search for the same thing in three different forms: in the Georgian alphabet, in Latin letters and, in some fields, in Russian. When working on SEO we have to account for all three.
მიზეზი ბევრია და ყველა ძალიან ადამიანური: There are many reasons, and all of them are very human. Some people don't have a Georgian keyboard on their phone at all. შედეგი ერთია: ერთი და იგივე მოთხოვნა სხვ: The result is the same: one query is written in different ways: “saxli qiravdeba”, “sakhli kiravdeba”, “სახლი ქირავდება”. Not everyone follows the same transliteration rule either: for some “ყ” is “y”, for others “q”, and for others “k”.
ვარაუდს მონაცემი ჯობია. ეს ოთხი წყარო უფ: Data beats guessing. These four sources are free and give you more than enough information:
<strong>Google Search Console</strong> —: Google Search Console: the “Performance” section shows the real queries people already use to find your site. This is often where Latin variants show up that you never even thought of.
<strong>Google Ads-ის Keyword Planner</s: Google Ads Keyword Planner: shows roughly how often each phrase is searched. Compare the Georgian and Latin versions with each other.
აღწერა, რომელიც თავად დაწერეთ და არა მომ: a description you wrote yourself rather than copied from the supplier's site; this helps both the buyer and Google;
ეს, ალბათ, ყველაზე ძვირი შეცდომაა. რეკლა: This is probably the most expensive mistake. The ad worked, someone wrote to you “how much is it?” and got a reply five hours later. By then they're already buying from a competitor.
ფასი, მიწოდების პირობები და მისამართი ყო: always keep the price, delivery terms and address at hand, even as ready templates.
<strong>Google-ის ავტომატური შევსება</st: Google autocomplete: start typing in the search box and see what it suggests. These are real, frequent queries.
<strong>თქვენი კლიენტები</strong> — გადა: Your customers: look through the messages you get on Messenger and by email. Which alphabet do they write in? Most likely they search on Google the same way.
აქ მთავარია ზომიერება. ლათინური ფრაზებით: Moderation is key here. Text stuffed with Latin phrases looks unprofessional and costs the visitor's trust. This is how we handle it:
<strong>ძირითადი კონტენტი — სუფთა ქართულ: Main content in clean Georgian. People read the site, and the text should be written for them.
<strong>ბრენდის სახელი ორივე ანბანით.</s: The brand name in both alphabets. If your business is called, say, “ოქროს ფურნე”, then “Oqros Purne” should naturally appear somewhere too: in the footer, on the contact page or in your Google Business Profile.

<strong>შედეგის შემოწმება.</strong> ცვლი: Checking the results. A few weeks after the change, check Search Console for new queries. SEO is a constant experiment, not a one-off decision.

7. შეფასებები: სთხოვეთ და უპასუხეთ: 7. Reviews: ask for them and reply
გაიხსენეთ, ბოლოს როგორ მოძებნეთ კაფე, აფ: Think back to the last time you looked for a café, a pharmacy or a tradesperson. Most likely you typed a few words into Google and first saw a map and three or four businesses, with addresses, reviews and photos. Your customers do exactly the same.
ამ ბლოკში მოსახვედრად საიტი აუცილებელი ა: You don't need a website to get into this block. What you do need is a well-filled Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business). Below we explain step by step how to set it up.
სანამ ახალს შექმნით, Google Maps-ში მოძე: Before creating a new one, search for your business on Google Maps. Often a profile already exists: customers or Google itself may have added it. In that case use the button to claim ownership of the business (“Claim this business”) and management passes to you. If there's no profile, create one at business.google.com.
Google-ს სჭირდება დარწმუნება, რომ ბიზნეს: Google needs to be sure the business is really yours. Google offers the method itself: it may be a short video, a call or SMS, an email, or sometimes a postcard.
ვიდეო ვერიფიკაცია ხშირია და მისთვის წინა: Video verification is common and worth preparing for. In one continuous shot, show the street and entrance, the sign with the business name, the interior and something that proves you run the place, for example the till, work tools or opening the door with your own key.
მთავარი კატეგორია ერთ-ერთი ყველაზე მნიშვ: The main category is one of the most important settings. Choose as precisely as possible: “dental clinic”, not just “clinic”; “pizzeria”, not just “restaurant”. Add other areas as additional categories, but only what you actually do.
სახელი ზუსტად ისე ჩაწერეთ, როგორც აბრაზე: Write the name exactly as it appears on your sign. It's tempting to add keywords to the name (“Luka: the best car service in Tbilisi”), but that's against Google's rules and can even get the profile suspended.
მისამართი და ტელეფონი ყველგან ერთნაირი უ: The address and phone should be the same everywhere: on the site, Facebook, Instagram and local directories. When the information matches everywhere, Google trusts you more.
ცოტა რამ აღიზიანებს კლიენტს ისე, როგორც: Few things annoy a customer as much as arriving at a locked door when Google said “open”. Give exact hours and add special hours for holidays: New Year, Christmas, Easter, Mariamoba, Giorgoba. It takes a few minutes and keeps customers' trust for a long time.
სტოკური ფოტოები აქ არ მუშაობს — ადამიანს: Stock photos don't work here; people need to see where they're going. Upload:
ფასადი და შესასვლელი — რომ ადგილზე მისულ: the façade and entrance, so people can find you easily on arrival;
შიდა სივრცე — დღის სინათლეზე და მოწესრიგ: the interior, in daylight and tidy;
გუნდი — ადამიანები სახეებს ენდობიან;: the team, because people trust faces;
კმაყოფილი კლიენტები შეფასებას იშვიათად წ: Satisfied customers rarely write reviews on their own; they just don't think of it. So ask: put a QR code by the till, send a link after the order or simply tell them their opinion matters to you.
უპასუხეთ ყველა შეფასებას — კარგსაც და ცუ: Reply to every review, good and bad. A calm, personal reply to a negative comment often says more about you than ten positive reviews. And don't even think about buying fake reviews: Google deletes them and the profile itself is put at risk.
Google ოფიციალურად სამ ფაქტორს ასახელებს: Google officially names three factors: relevance (how well the profile matches the search), distance (how close you are to the user) and prominence (reviews, links, general activity). You can't change distance, but the other two are entirely in your hands.
კარგად შევსებული პროფილი ერთჯერადი საქმე: A well-filled profile isn't a one-off job. Regularly updating photos, news and hours shows Google that the business is alive.
თუ პროფილის მოწყობა ან ვერიფიკაცია გაგიჭ: If setting up or verifying the profile is giving you trouble, write to us and we'll go through every step together.

ქვემოთ შვიდი შეცდომაა, რომლებიც ახალი კლ: Below are seven mistakes we see most often in new clients' ad accounts. The good news is that almost all of them are easy to fix.

ალგორითმი ზუსტად იმას აკეთებს, რასაც სთხ: The algorithm does exactly what you ask. If you choose “engagement” as the objective, it brings people who click like, not people who buy. If you need messages, leads or sales, the campaign objective has to match.
Meta Pixel და Conversions API საიტზე მომ: The Meta Pixel and Conversions API send actions on your site (an order, a form submission, an add to cart) to Facebook. Keep an eye on the “Frequency” metric and refresh visuals regularly. A good practice is to run three or four variants at once and keep the one that works best.
ქართული აუდიტორია ისედაც მცირეა. როცა ას: The Georgian audience is small as it is. A broad audience with a strong, clear visual often gives better results; the algorithm finds the right people itself.
ლაიქი სასიამოვნოა, მაგრამ მისით ხელფასს: Likes are nice, but you can't pay salaries with them. Measure what matters for the business:

ონლაინ მაღაზია ამ ქაოსს ალაგებს, მაგრამ: An online store sorts out this chaos, but only if you think a few important things through in advance. Here's what we ask every new client.

გაითვალისწინეთ ისიც, რომ ბევრი მყიდველი: Keep in mind too that many buyers still prefer to pay on delivery, and for expensive products, in instalments. The more familiar options you offer, the fewer carts get abandoned.
მყიდველს უნდა იცოდეს, რამდენი დაუჯდება მ: The buyer should know how much delivery will cost and when they'll receive the item before they even reach the cart. List Tbilisi and the regions separately. If you work with a courier company, agree in advance how you'll get information on parcel status.
ნამდვილი ფოტოები რამდენიმე კუთხიდან — სა: real photos from several angles, ideally on one background and in one style;
ზომები, მასალა, მოვლის ინსტრუქცია — ქართ: sizes, material and care instructions, clear and in Georgian;
a clear price and stock status.
როგორც წესი, ონლაინ მაღაზიის ვიზიტორების: As a rule, most of an online store's visitors come from a phone. So check every page on a phone first: is the “Add to cart” button visible without scrolling, how many fields does the buyer fill in at checkout and how fast do the photos load?
ყიდვამდე მყიდველს ხშირად კითხვა უჩნდება:: Before buying, buyers often have a question: “Will this size fit me?”, “Will it arrive tomorrow?”. Add a WhatsApp, Viber or Messenger button so people can get in touch without leaving the site, and reply quickly.
